reports.definitions.period: Hotel business dates; includes the start date and excludes the end date.
reports.definitions.forecastRoomRevenue: Finalized nightly room prices for booked and occupied rooms; excludes cancelled and no-show bookings.
reports.definitions.roomRevenue: Room prices for completed nights before today from checked-in or checked-out bookings.
reports.definitions.adr: Room revenue for completed nights divided by the corresponding room nights; excludes services, taxes and fees.
reports.definitions.realizedRevenue: Nightly prices and pre-checkout charges from checked-out bookings are recorded on the actual checkout date; post-checkout adjustments use their adjustment date. Retail POS is recorded on closing and reversed on cancellation; POS posted to a booking is counted only with that booking. This is finalized invoice revenue, not night-audit revenue recognition.
reports.definitions.netReceipts: Booking and POS receipts minus refunds by posting date; this is not revenue.
reports.definitions.cashbook: Opening balance plus total income minus total expenses equals the ledger closing balance; includes opening entries, fund transfers and reversals.
reports.definitions.snapshot: Deposits and receivables are current balances at asOf, not period totals: deposits equal payments minus refunds for CONFIRMED bookings; receivables equal positive balances on open bookings and finalized retail POS invoices.
reports.definitions.capacity: Occupancy uses the rooms currently active; historical changes to total room count are not retained.
reports.definitions.moneyBasisOriginal: Original amounts use each document's currency; amounts in different currencies are not combined.
reports.definitions.moneyBasisBase: Base amounts use the saved baseCurrency and baseAmount on each document; the exchange rate at posting time is preserved and is not recalculated using the current rate.
reports.definitions.roomType: The room type saved in the booking; the displayed room-type name is the current name.
reports.definitions.bookings: Booking count in each group; a multi-room booking can appear in multiple room or room-type groups.
reports.definitions.cancellations: Grouped by the hotel's actual cancellation date. Cancelled room value is the price of all saved nights, not lost revenue or a cancellation fee.
reports.definitions.nationality: Nationality from the current guest profile, across all currencies. Counts unique guests and guest nights overlapping the period for checked-in or checked-out bookings; historical nationality and group join/leave dates are not retained.
reports.definitions.discounts: Bookings created during the period, excluding cancelled and no-show bookings. The name, policy and discount amount come from the pricing snapshot saved on the booking; repricing a booking may change that snapshot. Current promotion settings are not reapplied.
reports.definitions.groupTotals: Bookings and quantities are calculated per group; summing groups may count multi-room bookings or guests with multiple nationalities more than once.
